Will estimate average screening costs associated with MCD testing, evaluation of abnormal MCD tests, standard of care screening and evaluation of abnormal standard of care screening results (all MCD arm participants are encouraged to receive standard of care screening), plus cancer site and stage specific treatment costs sourced from the published literature.

Participant and caregiver time spent away from work will be estimated using an adapted version of the Productivity Cost Questionnaire. The dollar value of hours recorded for participant work loss and caregiver time will be estimated using wages from the Bureau of Labor Statistics.

interpretation_boundaries: This packet audits public protocol semantics and endpoint-to-claim alignment only.
It does not recommend an MCD assay, screening decision, diagnostic procedure, treatment, or trial participation.
It does not analyze participant-level data or compare the two MCD assays.
It does not establish mortality benefit, personalized treatment, cure, regulatory authorization, or a solved frontier.

primary_threshold_audit.definition: A numeric go/no-go threshold must state an explicit cutoff or inequality for the endpoint measure itself. A measurement window, estimated enrollment, or reference to unspecified trial goals is not a success threshold.

question: When does a registered cancer-screening outcome support feasibility, assay performance, mortality benefit, or personalized cure—and when does it support none of them yet?
